summary: Compare real estate debt capacity, equity returns and funding risks. Review project financing tools and build a practical funding recommendation.
lede: Debt and equity financing for real estate projects matches funding needs with borrowing and investor capital. For development finance professionals, analysts and project sponsors, the work includes reconciling sources and uses, testing debt capacity and repayment coverage, comparing equity returns, and reviewing term-sheet provisions. Scenario analysis helps assess funding risks and prepare a clear financing recommendation.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who shape, assess or negotiate real estate project funding, from early feasibility through funding discussions. It suits you if your work involves project cash flows, lender requirements, investment returns or funding recommendations.
modules: Debt Capacity: LTC, LTV and Debt Yield
Cash Flow Coverage: DSCR and Stress Tests
prerequisites: Working knowledge of real estate project cash flows, basic financial statements and spreadsheet calculations is expected. No coding or programming is required.
